channel.title: Mali - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mali, every source cited.

item.title: Malian women's group collects over 58 million FCFA
item.description: The Femmes solidaires et autonomes du Mali announced their 2026 financial contributions at their annual general assembly.

item.title: Mali state security holds lawyer for six months
item.description: Mountaga Tall, a former minister and democracy advocate, was abducted from his home by state security agents.

item.title: Kayes associations fight drug proliferation
item.description: Community groups in Kayes held a debate on October 31, 2026, to raise awareness about drug dangers.

item.title: Mali distributes aid to vulnerable populations
item.description: Rice, oil, and school kits were given to people with disabilities in Kadiolo, Bafoulabé, and Mahina.

item.title: Mali journalists' murder case sees partial declassification
item.description: A French court seeks to declassify a note from April 2024 related to the 2013 killings.
